#8 Urs: edit did show regularly after submit – it immediately reflects in the show. But clicking on edit again shows the edit window with the state of the source in the box predating the edit already reflected in the show! So if you resubmit the edit box it will return to the previous state, erasing the edits.

That was yesterday evening, as a persistent problem, but now it seems things do work OK.
